# Yiling Hijab — Custom Printed Modal Hijab Manufacturer

> Yiwu Yiling Clothing Co., Ltd. is a hijab manufacturer and wholesale
> supplier based in Yiwu, Zhejiang, China, founded in 2008. We specialise in
> custom printed modal hijabs, jersey modal hijabs, Pantone-matched solid
> colours, bespoke hemming, and jersey hijab undercaps — produced for
> private-label brands, boutiques, and wholesale distributors worldwide.
> MOQ is 100 pieces per colourway. Rated 4.9 / 5 across 283 verified reviews.

## What we actually are

- **Type**: Factory / OEM & ODM manufacturer (not a reseller or trading company)
- **Founded**: 2008
- **Location**: Yiwu, Zhejiang Province, China
- **MOQ**: 100 pieces per colourway
- **Sample lead time**: ~7 days
- **Bulk lead time**: 25–35 days
- **Price range**: USD $2.40 – $5.80 per piece depending on style and volume
- **Markets served**: USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Indonesia, Malaysia, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Germany, France, Netherlands
- **Rating**: 4.9 / 5 from 283 verified buyer reviews
- **Contact**: peri@wennuanfactory.com · +86 150 8824 8404

## Product lines

- **Custom Printed Modal Hijab** — reactive dye printing on 160 GSM modal,
  180 x 75 cm. Customer artwork accepted. From $5.80/pc at MOQ 100.
  https://yilinghijab.com/products
- **Jersey Modal Hijab** — 180 GSM modal-jersey blend, four-way stretch,
  70 x 170 cm, opaque coverage. From $4.80/pc at MOQ 100.
  https://yilinghijab.com/products
- **Custom Pantone Modal Hijab** — Pantone-referenced solid colour matching
  for brand-specific palettes. https://yilinghijab.com/products
- **Custom Hemming** — rolled edge, overlocked, and flat-lock finishes.
  https://yilinghijab.com/products
- **Custom Jersey Cap** — jersey hijab undercaps with tie-back or long ties,
  180 GSM modal-jersey, one size. From $3.20/pc at MOQ 100.
  https://yilinghijab.com/products

## Capabilities buyers ask about

- Custom artwork printing (reactive dye, wash-fast, Pantone-calibrated)
- Private label: woven labels, care labels, hang tags, retail packaging
- Custom fabric weight (GSM) and cut size on bulk orders
- Pre-production samples before bulk commitment
- Repeat-order colour consistency via Pantone reference
- Defect rate below 0.3%; replacement or refund on quality issues
